text:
Major John Andre Hanged
Thirty-one-year-old British Major John Andre is hanged as a spy by U.S. military forces in Tappan, New York, on this day in 1780.
Andre, an accomplice of Benedict Arnold, had been captured by Patriots John Paulding, David Williams and Isaac Van Wart on September 23 after they found incriminating papers in his boot. The papers revealed that Andre was returning from a secret meeting with U.S. General Benedict Arnold, commander of West Point, who had offered to surrender the strategic Hudson River fort to the British for a bribe of £20,000. Upon hearing of Andre's capture, Arnold fled to the British warship Vulture and subsequently joined the British in their fight against the Patriots.
After being sentenced to death by U.S. authorities on September 29, Andre was allowed to write a letter to his commander, General Henry Clinton. Andre also wrote a letter to General George Washington in which he asked, not that his life be spared, but that he be executed by firing squad. Death by firing squad was considered a more "gentlemanly" death than hanging.

#ISPR
Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, NI (M), HJ, Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces (COAS & CDF), presided over the 277th Corps Commanders’ Conference at General Headquarters (GHQ), Rawalpindi.

The Forum offered Fateha for the Shuhada of the Armed Forces, Law Enforcement Agencies and civil society who laid down their lives for the motherland and paid rich tribute to their supreme sacrifices.

The forum reviewed the prevailing security environment and resolved to maintain a high state of readiness. It affirmed Pakistan’s right to self-defence and targeted action against terrorism emanating from Afghanistan, stressing that only the Taliban delusional leadership,  facilitating terrorism on behalf of India, bears responsibility for its consequences. 

Forum appreciated sustained successful intelligence-based counter-terrorism operations by law enforcement agencies, however, emphasised complementing these kinetic efforts with non-kinetic measures; including people-centric governance at grassroot level, strategic engagement with public, dismantling of terror-crime nexus operating under patronage of vested interests and police capacity building, in line with the National Action Plan and Vision Azm-e-Istehkam.

Forum underscored the importance of internal stability and resolved that any  attempt to cause agitation or create 9th May like situation, on any pretext whatsoever, will be dealt with decisive force and rule of law, without hesitation and discrimination. 

The forum welcomed the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Türkiye, noting its contribution to longstanding strategic and collective defence ties. It strongly resented Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia, expressed solidarity with the Kingdom and affirmed Pakistan’s commitment to the security and sanctity of the Haramain Sharifain. It also reiterated Pakistan’s principled position on IIOJK and support for resolution of the Kashmir dispute in accordance with relevant UN Security Council resolutions and the aspirations of the Kashmiri people.

In his concluding remarks, COAS & CDF commended the formations for their operational preparedness and professionalism. He directed commanders to continue to strengthen intelligence-based operations and enhance combat capabilities through absorption of modern technology, training and multi-domain integration. He expressed confidence that the Armed Forces, with unwavering support of the nation, remain fully prepared to safeguard Pakistan’s sovereignty, territorial integrity and national security.

We all know the brutal conflict in Sudan between the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) & the regular army has been raging since April 2023. But just yesterday, a massive bomb dropped in Malawi: General Paul Valentino Phiri was arrested by the Anti-Corruption Bureau. The charge? Alleged involvement in property deals linked to "terrorism." In plain terms, he’s accused of helping arm Sudanese rebels with heavy weaponry.

This isn't a sudden development. Back in July 2025, a Platform for Investigative Journalism (PIJ) report revealed that US intelligence believed top Malawian military officials were secretly funnelling heavy arms to Sudan.

Now, this is where Wicknell Chivayo enters the frame. It’s well-documented that Chivayo met with former Malawian President Peter Mutharika multiple times, & he also had sit-downs with Lazarus Chakwera. While the investigators targeting General Phiri haven’t officially named the financial backer behind these massive weapon shipments—which are rumoured to be worth up to $4 billion—the word on the street points squarely at Chivayo. We all know Chivayo was just a front. There is really only one person who controls that kind of liquid cash, largely because they can’t use standard banking channels.
While there is no paper trail proving who funded the July 2025 weapons shipment, look at the timeline: on July 15, 2025, Chivayo flew into Malawi & met with then-President Chakwera. Is that just a coincidence? Highly unlikely. I mean days before the shipment.

To understand the scale of this, you have to look at the money. Gold is the lifeblood of the RSF; they control the mines in Darfur, mill the ore, & smuggle the metal out of Sudan. That’s where Kenya comes in as a major transit hub. Including Tanzania. In February 2025, Nairobi even hosted RSF political meetings, & Kenyan President William Ruto was spotted personally chauffeuring Chivayo around recently. Ruto himself has faced heavy accusations of holding personal & commercial ties to the RSF, mostly tied to gold smuggling. To add fuel to the fire, in June 2025, the Sudanese government claimed they discovered Kenyan-labelled weapons and ammunition hidden in RSF caches across Khartoum and Omdurman.
Chivayo simply knew too much. It's telling that he wasn't around to see General Phiri's arrest. Did the heat finally get to him? Did US intelligence catch up with him? Or did his handlers realize the net was closing in, choosing to eliminate him & his wife—who was by his side through it all—to erase their own ties to international terrorism?

What happened right after Chivayo’s helicopter crashed tells you everything you need to know. Within minutes, the army swarmed his mansion & completely locked it down. Nobody was allowed inside. Not family, not friends—absolutely no one.

Neighbours made complaints about mysterious digging in Chivayo’s garden. The excavation was so intense that tunnels began collapsing, causing cracks to ripple through the walls of neighbouring homes. Chivayo was hoarding billions in gold, diamonds, & cash on that property because the people he associated with couldn't—or wouldn't—use banks. Tanzania president even offered to send mercenaries to help secure the house.

The sanctioned Dagalo family, who fund the RSF, have deep ties here. RSF leader Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo has held meetings with the exact same presidents we used to see Chivayo rubbing shoulders with. Including Rhamaposa who enjoyed an exclusive meeting with him.

Ultimately, Chivayo wanted to play with the big boys, but his pathological need to show off was his downfall. He ended up in a black bin bag. He was a careles operator who facilitated the funding of terrorism, smuggled gold, & laundered money, all while bleeding taxpayers dry to fund his lavish lifestyle.

Religious Liberty Commission Report Top 10 Series - Point 2: Who Forms YOUR Conscience?

“Religious liberty does not divide… it forms conscience, and a society without conscience cannot sustain freedom.” - Dr. Paul Brintley, RL Commission Report p.122

On page 30, the Religious Liberty Commission report calls “Religion” the “Conscience of the State.” It says, “[r]eligion offers moral standards to which government can be held accountable, keeping tyranny at bay.”

Who decides what religion’s “moral standards” the government is held accountable to? Who “forms conscience?”

Not Buddhists– there was not a single Buddhist on the Commission. Or a professed Hindu, Sikh, atheist, agnostic, Mormon, or Jehovah’s Witness. And clearly Islam doesn’t meet criteria, per both Eric Metaxas and Dan Patrick (although there was one Muslim on the Commission – who happened to have been baptized, raised, and schooled Catholic).

The Commission Report goes further:

“This is how religious leaders serve, as the Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King put it, as “the conscience of the state… Being the conscience of the state requires pastors and religious leaders who courageously bring God’s word to the public square.” (p121)

Which specific religious leaders might be envisioned here?

For starters, in the section entitled, “The Conscience of the State,” it gives two examples: “At times in our history when our country has not lived up to those self-evident truths, religion calls the country back. We see this corrective role played by religious Americans throughout history… in Reverend Martin Luther King Jr.’s reliance upon St. Thomas Aquinas, St. Augustine, and a higher moral law…” (p30)

Please be careful not to use political categories to speak about faith, to speak about the Church, the Church doesn’t belong to any political party. Rather, she helps form YOUR CONSCIENCE.”

“The Church” helps form your conscience. What church? The Catholic Church specifically.

This may be able to be dismissed as a one-off coincidence – if the rest of the report didn’t mirror Pope Leo’s other statements so precisely.

There’s a bold heading entitled, “Where We Are Now: Building Bridges Between Church and State,” under which is written: “Americans must know their rights and stand with courage when those rights are challenged. Religious liberty does not divide. Wall down, bridge up. A specific Church and specific religious leader(s) form conscience.

“For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,  who gave Himself a ransom for all…” - 1 Timothy 2:5,6.

That same Religious Liberty is a “bridge between the city of God and the city of man”

… which necessitates tearing down the wall of separation between church and state

Religious leaders serve as “the conscience of the state” (but not all – because not all religions are equal or represented in the Religious Liberty Commission)

The Report highlights only two religious figures that the man who said this relied upon, and both were Catholic saints

Pope Leo XIV says the Catholic Church in specific “helps form your conscience.”

Nearly half of this Commission is Catholic.

Real religious liberty is an A - B conversation between an individual and the God of their beliefs or lack thereof. There is no “bridge” between God and man but Christ. There is no third party involved. There is no government mediator. There is no sinful human priest, pope, or church institution that stands between an individual and their God. Nothing and no one forms human conscience outside of that A - B relationship.

This Commission is redefining the very idea of Religious Liberty to covertly reverse its meaning and add in a third party where there has never been one in the history of this country – by design of its Founders – and almost no one is noticing.

Even more concerning is who exactly is ready and waiting to step into that space – with bells on:

It’s at a minimum an abuse of position of power and influence, and a potential violation if not outright violation of the UCMJ.

The rules regarding religion, proselytizing, and command influence in the military are governed by the U.S. Constitution (First Amendment), Department of Defense (DoD) Directives and Instructions, and specific punitive articles under the Uniform Code of Military Justice (UCMJ).

While the military protects a service member's individual right to practice their religion (or no religion at all) under the Free Exercise Clause, it strictly prohibits official endorsement, coercion, or proselytizing, especially by individuals in leadership positions.
 
1. What Do DoD Regulations Say About Proselytizing and Religious Influence?

Department of Defense and service-specific regulations (such as DoDI 1300.17 Religious Liberty in the Military Service and various branch regulations on Equal Opportunity and command climate) draw a sharp line between personal practice and official endorsement:

No Official Promotion: Military leaders (officers and NCOs) are explicitly forbidden from using their rank, position, or authority to promote their personal religious beliefs to subordinates or to give preferential treatment to any specific faith.  

The "Coercion" Standard: Because of the inherent power dynamics in the military, a leader talking about religion or attempting to convert a subordinate can easily be perceived as an order or an implicit requirement. Therefore, proselytizing to subordinates on duty, in the workplace, or leveraging command channels to push a religious agenda is strictly barred.  

Neutrality: The military as an institution must remain strictly neutral. It cannot declare or imply that one religion is the "correct" way or that religion is preferred over non-belief.  

2. How Does the UCMJ Handle Violations?
While there is no specific article in the UCMJ titled "Proselytizing" or "Religious Discrimination," violations of these rules are prosecuted under several general punitive articles:

Article 92 (Failure to Obey Order or Regulation): Violating lawful general orders or instructions issued by the DoD or service branches regarding religious accommodation, equal opportunity, or command climate is a direct violation of Article 92.

Article 133 (Conduct Unbecoming an Officer and a Gentleman): If an officer uses their position to pressure subordinates into religious activities, disparages other faiths, or engages in heavy-handed proselytizing, it is routinely charged as conduct unbecoming an officer.

Article 134 (General Article - Disorders and Neglect to the Prejudice of Good Order and Discipline): Enlisted members or officers whose religious proselytizing creates friction, disrupts unit cohesion, harasses peers, or undermines good order and discipline can be prosecuted under the General Article.

3. Key Distinctions: What is Allowed vs. Prohibited?
When it comes to personal beliefs, service members are permitted to practice their faith privately, wear authorized religious apparel with proper accommodation, or read religious texts on their own time. Regarding leader speech, leaders may engage in voluntary, informal personal discussions among peers where it is clear the conversation has nothing to do with official command policy. Finally, for prayers and invocations, they are handled primarily by chaplains who are trained to offer inclusive, non-denominational prayers or moments of silence at major official ceremonies like changes of command or retirements.

In short, saying "one religion is the way" on a personal basis outside of work hours among consenting peers is protected free speech. However, doing so as a leader, in a professional military capacity, or in a way that pressures subordinates crosses the line into unconstitutional government establishment of religion and subjects the individual to potential UCMJ action and administrative discipline.

text:
A Daily Dose of Talmud
Daf Yomi for Everyone, from My Jewish Learning

Bekhorot 14
Read the page on Sefaria
Dr. Sara Ronis
It is not permissible to offer an animal with a disqualifying blemish on the altar in the Temple. But does this mean you can’t dedicate one as a gift to God? Today’s daf explores: What happens if you consecrate an animal that is blemished?  The mishnah on today’s daf teaches:   All sacrificial animals in which a permanent blemish preceded their consecration, and they were redeemed, are obligated in the mitzvah of a firstborn, and in the priestly gifts, and they can emerge as non-sacred to be shorn and to be utilized for labor. And their offspring and their milk are permitted after their redemption.  We’ve already seen this exact mishnah in Chullin 130a. Interestingly, it appears in the Mishnah twice, once in Chullin and once here in Bekhorot, probably because its teaching is directly relevant to both the topic of mundane animals slaughtered for food and the topic of firstborn animals.   Reading the mishnah carefully, we can see that if you dedicate a blemished animal to the Temple, the dedication works — but only partially. The animal is dedicated insofar as it cannot be used for wool or labor until it has been redeemed. But it is not exempt from the mitzvah of firstborns (should it give birth), or from having certain portions of its meat given to the priests (in the event that it is slaughtered for food), as other dedicated animals are.   Based on this mishnah, the Talmudinfers that:  The reason (that these animals with preexisting blemishes are subject to the obligations of a firstborn and the priestly gifts) is that they were redeemed. But if they were not redeemed, they are exempt from their offspring being counted as firstborns and from the gifts to priests. This tanna of the mishnah holds: Sanctity of monetary value defers, i.e., renders it exempt, from the mitzvah of the firstborn and from the gifts. “And they can emerge as non-sacred”: The reason is that they were redeemed. But if they were not redeemed, they are prohibited with regard to shearing and labor.   The Talmud’s inference clarifies how the rabbis thought consecration actually worked in this case. If you dedicate a blemished animal to the Temple, what you are actually dedicating is that animal’s monetary value. That is why the animal can be redeemed — meaning its sanctity can be transferred to something else which becomes dedicated in its place. And because you haven’t actually dedicated the blemished animal’s body (just its monetary value), the highest level of Temple sanctity never applies to it. This means that, once redeemed, it goes back to its normal status and is treated like a regular mundane animal when it comes to the mitzvah of the firstborn and the priestly portions (jaws, maw and foreleg) that are donated to priests should the animal be slaughtered for food. And, of course, the animal can provide wool and labor once redeemed.   We might have thought that one who intentionally dedicated a blemished animal to the Temple would be penalized in some way for bringing God less than their best. Maybe they’d lose their blemished animal, and be required to bring an unblemished animal to the Temple anyway. Maybe they’d have to pay some other kind of penalty. Instead, the rabbis declare that these kinds of dedications do work, at least partially. You can’t actually offer the blemished animal on the altar, but the gift is still meaningful: The value of the animal is now pledged to the Temple coffers, and the animal is set aside until it can be redeemed.   Why might someone dedicate an animal they know cannot actually be offered? Perhaps this is a person who has only a blemished animal, and wants to give God a gift. Rather than excluding this person from making a gift of their imperfect animal, the rabbis find a way to make that gift possible.

text:
🌸 The Birth of Blessing Packets 🌷

The tiny Blessing packets, associated with our Ashram, are unique in themselves in many and varied ways.

They have travelled all over the world, may it be by road, steamships, naval vessels, or on ordinary yet adventurous country rafts, on aircrafts like helicopters, supersonics, air buses, gliders, balloons, or even by Migs, by trains, by cars, by buses, by bullock-carts. But most of all they have travelled on bicycles, placed with love and reverence in the pockets of devotees. They travel very often close to the hearts of people.

 If the small Blessing packet is seen in whichever corner of the world it be it is at once connected with the Mother of the Sri Aurobindo Ashram,  Pondicherry. There is nothing of the kind anywhere else associated with any spiritual group or temple. If there is a Blessing wrapped in a small 4 cms by 3 cms envelope made of decorated paper with the seal of a symbol, sure enough it has come from the Sri Aurobindo Ashram.

 They are not only unique in their appearance; they have thousands and millions of stories to tell, each one unique in its own way.

This one was told by the Mother. Once a man was travelling by bus. It was in Goa, during the struggle for freedom from the Portuguese rule. Often there were mobs on the way. Stopping the vehicles, looting, stoning, even killing the passengers. This man was leaving Goa and on the way the bus was stopped. There was utter chaos and confusion and crying and shrieking. He was very scared. But at some moment he remembered about the Blessing packet in his pocket. He clutched at it and called for help. There is no need to say anything more. As experienced by many the help was there. It is a matter of faith, the Mother had said once.

 This tiny packet had a very simple and humble birth. Our Champaklal-ji has this to say:

 "Early in the beginning the Mother used to give a rose to sadhaks who went to Her for Pranam. Then She started giving rose petals.

Some people were very careful, they received the petals with both hands and put them in their handkerchief or pocket. Their feelings and reverence could be seen in their action. They were so consciously careful that even if a tiny petal fell down their unhappiness could be seen on their face. They would delicately lift the dropped petal, touch it to their eyes and forehead before placing it in the handkerchief. It was a scene steeped in bhakti.

 While, alas, some others were careless, and were in a hurry. They seemed as if snatching the petals or a rose from Her hands. They would quickly push them in their pocket dropping a few petals on their way out. A few would turn back to pick up the petals; they would receive a lovely smile from the Mother. Some did not bother. But often lucky ones were called back by the Mother. She would sweetly point at the petals on the ground."

When Champaklal saw all this, as he was always near Her when people went to Her for Pranam, he started making little packets for the petals. The very first ones were made by an old sadhak, Charu Dutt. He used to come to the Mother with lots of reverence and devotion, but could not manage the loose petals. So the tiny envelopes were specially made by him.

Thus was born the Blessing packet made in simple butter paper. Then Birendra, another sadhak, offered to make these envelopes with symbols embossed on the flap.

When the marbling of paper started in the Ashram, this paper made its way to the making of the second decorative envelope for the butter-paper bag holding the rose petals. Then came the work of drying the rose petals and pressing them flat. Lots of senior sadhaks are now busy making these Blessing packets.

With the practice of using decorative covers becoming common, fancy paper from all over the world started arriving in sweet competition, asking to be used for the purpose. And what a variety of beautiful paper poured in.

BANG CHAN became famous globally as the frontman, lead Vocalist, lead Rapper, Dancer and Producer of the chart-topping, record-breaking, history-making Iconic Band Stray Kids! Bang Chan is a multi-talented Superstar, and one of the Best Asian leaders, singing and rapping at a very high level! He's not just an incredible performer, he's the main reason Stray Kids sound like they do! With 3RACHA he writes, composes, arranges, and produces most of the group’s music, steering a catalog that is fierce with lyrics that explore identity, pressure, and belonging! The intense, narrative edge people associate with Stray Kids is, in large part, his hand on the songs! In 2026 he made history, becoming the idol with the most works registered with the Korea Music Copyright Association, KOMCA (244)! He also writes tracks for other artists, anime and drama projects, and film placements including Deadpool & Wolverine. Bang Chan is Fluent in Korean, English, and basic Japanese, and is also a hugely talented musician who plays the piano, guitar, drums and beatboxes. He also takes center stage in the group's choreography, and is an amazing professional Dancer, having trained in ballet and modern dance at the Newtown High School of Performing Arts in Australia where he lived till the age of 13. He also swam competitively, winning several medals, including breaking his school's 50m freestyle record at age 8! He is also a fitness powerhouse, and deadlifts over 160kg, practices boxing, and maintains peak condition to support Stray Kids' high-energy routines! 

Bang Chan is famous for his amazing voice, and sings at times like an Angel after beginning his music career in his school choir! After passing a JYP audition in Australia in 2010, he relocated from Sydney without his family, training for seven years, the longest among Stray Kids members! Bang Chan met future bandmates Han and Changbin while taking MIDI classes and in 2016 they formed the hip-hop group 3 RACHA! Bang Chan uploaded their first mixtape, 'J:/2017/mixtape', to SoundCloud in January 2017 and that same year, he took part in JYP Entertainment's survival show called 'Stray Kids', playing a key role in forming the group, selecting the trainees, choosing the group's name, and designing their logo. During a 2017 survival show performance, he was half-paralyzed from exhaustion and injury but powered through without anyone noticing, earning praise for his professionalism. In early 2018, Stray Kids released their first pre-debut album EP Mixtape featuring the group's self-composed songs from the survival show. Bang Chan officially debuted as the leader of Stray Kids on March 25, 2018, and flew the band to his homeland Australia as part of their first variety show, 'Finding SKZ'. He and Hyunjin's first collaborative sub-unit track "Red Lights", debuted at #30 on the Circle Download chart and was included in Stray Kids' 2nd studio album, 'NoEasy', becoming one of the group's top 20 most-streamed songs! He also took part in the soft rock track "Waiting For Us" with Lee Know, Seungmin & IN, which featured on 'Oddinary' (2022) and debuted at #25 on the Circle Download Chart! In 2020, he featured on Changbin's track "Streetlight", and released his own self-composed solo track "I Hate to Admit" via the SKZ-RECORD series. In 2021, he featured on I.N.'s solo song "Maknae on Top" with Changbin and released a cover of Taylor Swift's "ME!" with Twice's Tzuyu. He also released "Drive" that year with Lee Know, followed by "Zone" with Han for the SKZ-Replay album, and his self-composed solo track "Connected". Bang Chan received critical acclaim for the song "3RACHA", which he co-wrote and co-composed and which debuted at #36 on the Circle Download Chart for the week 2-8 Oct, 2022, ranking 14th on NME's year-end list. As part of 3RACHA, he also co-wrote, composed, and performed "Heyday" for the 'Street Man Fighter' soundtrack. In 2023, during the 5-Star Dome Tour, he performed his unreleased song "Baby" at the Tokyo Dome. In March 2024, he released the MV for his English single "Eternity", which featured his pet dog, Berry and was the vocal arranger for the JYP-produced single "Like Magic", created for Coca-Cola's K-Wave campaign. In September, 2024, during the Dominate tour, Bang Chan performed his unreleased solo song "Railway" for the first time ever. The song was later included on the 'Hop' album and officially released on December 13, reaching #33 on the Circle Digital chart in Korea and #15 on the Hot New Zealand chart. In 2025, he released his solo hit "Escape" with Hyunjin, reaching #1 on the World Digital Song Sales chart, #35 on the UK sales chart and #24 on the Hot New Zealand chart! In April 2025, Bang Chan also featured on Astro's special release, "Moon: Memory of the Moon", a tribute to Moonbin on the 2nd anniversary of his death. The song peaked at No. 4 on the World Digital Song Sales chart. On November 3, 2025, he released the "Roman Empire” video, a Fendi collaboration, written and produced by him, which later landed on SKZ-Replay 2026 Pt.1, and debuted at No. 2 on the Genius Hot Top 100 and No. 6 on the U.S. iTunes K-pop chart! In 2026 he released “BABY" on that same Replay set after an unreleased Tokyo Dome performance, which hit No. 16 on the U.S. iTunes K-pop chart.  

Bang Chan has also written tracks for JO1, YaoChen, and ShowLo and collaborated with Alesso, the Japanese singer LiSA, SkyHi, TigerJK & LilDurk! In February 2022, Bang Chan co-wrote and featured on the song "Just Breathe" with Japanese rapper Sky-Hi. He and the other 3Racha members were awarded Best Hip Hop Video at the MTV VMAs Japan 2022 for their work on the track! In March, 2022, Bang Chan co-wrote and produced the song "YOLO-konde" for the Japanese global boy band JO1 as a theme song to support the group and their fans. Bang Chan has also composed for various TV series, including  'Pop Out Boy!', 'Tower of God', and 'Arcane', and for the films 'Doraemon: Nobita's Sky Utopia' and 'Deadpool & Wolverine'. 

Bang Chan is also a Live Powerhouse! On stage he holds the center as leader, lead vocalist, and lead dancer, carrying long sets with stable vocals, sharp rap, and full choreography, and still has enough energy left to talk the crowd through the night. Offstage, the same stamina shows up in Chan’s Room with hours-long livestreams where he sings, produces, and stays with fans until late at night. His Tour solos like “Railway” and “Baby” began as live hits onstage before they were released!

Bang Chan is also an amazing TV host, and in July 2024, he and Felix hosted the radio series 'All About Stray Kids Radio' on Apple Music Radio, interviewing Ryan Reynolds and Hugh Jackman for Deadpool & Wolverine in Seoul, South Korea, as part of a promotional event for Marvel Korea.

Bang Chan has won numerous awards as part of Stray kids and also several awards for his own solo work, including Best Hip Hop Video at the MTV VMAs Japan 2022 for his work on the track "Just Breathe" and Best Creator Award with Han & Changbin at the 2023 Asia Artist Awards for his contribution as a songwriter and producer! Billboard ranked Bang Chan 2nd in their 2024 K-Pop Artist 100! In 2023 he ranked 8th on TC Candler's "100 Most Handsome Faces of 2023"! In 2025, Bang Chan won Best Producer at the 2025 Asia Artist Awards as part of 3Racha. In 2025, he was also nominated for Best Producer at the 2025 Asian Pop Music Awards for KARMA, with Versachoi. He has been nominated in his own name for a 2026 Korea Grand Music Award for K-Wave Popularity and is still pending!

Bang Chan is a Fashion Icon and in February 2024, he made his solo debut on the cover of Nylon Japan's special edition themed "One Love, One Life," featuring Swarovski's jewelry with his own double cover, emphasizing his role as the leader of Stray Kids!  In May, 2024, he made his Met Gala debut with the group as a guest of Tommy Hilfiger and appeared on the cover of W Korea's Volume 6, showcasing Fendi's summer capsule collection. In June he made his solo debut at Milan Fashion Week, wowing at Fendi's 2025 Spring/Summer men's fashion show & generating $3.43 million in Earned Media Value (EMV), making him the fifth most influential figure at the event! On 16 January 2025, Bang Chan became the new Fendi brand ambassador, embodying 4th-gen K-pop leadership by encouraging authenticity and creativity, and starred on the cover of the February issue of Harper's Bazaar Korea and the digital covers for Harper's Bazaar Thailand, Harper's Bazaar Men Taiwan and the print and digital editions of Harper's Bazaar Singapore, and the May 2025 issue of Harper's Bazaar Japan. On 16 February, 2025 he was the star guest at the Milan Fashion Week for Fendi Women's and Men's Fall/Winter 2025/2026 collection and on September 24, 2025, he caused a sensation at the FendiSS26 woman's Fashion show, in a show stopping see-thru lace shirt and black leather coat, rocking a Lui bag and O'Lock earrings which sold out immediately further confirming his global influence. Bang Chan is still Fendi's most visible K-pop face. In November 2025 the partnership moved into music, after Bang Chan wrote and produced “Roman Empire,” a Fendi single whose video was shot at the brand’s Rome headquarters, the Palazzo della Civiltà Italiana, with Peekaboo and FF logos written into the lyrics, and Bang Chan wearing Fendi throughout, keeping the Baguette as a signature off the runway. In September 2026 he made a huge comeback in Milan for Fendi’s Spring/Summer 2027 show, again seated in the front row best VIP spot rocking a black nylon coat, tailored trousers, shirt and tie, technical sneakers and a black Baguette, a look GQ España among other media raved about. A week after the show he was still hailed in the Press as one of Fendi's leading front row faces! 

Bang Chan is a very active philanthropist, and in 2021, he took part in JYP Entertainment's 'Every Dream Matters'(EDM) with TWICE's Sana and company founder ParkJinYoung, promoting various charitable projects for children battling terminal and incurable illnesses. In 2023 he co-hosted the 4th 'EDM Day' with Park and TWICE's Jihyo, taking part in the 'Love Earth' Challenge campaign. In August 2023 Bang Chan performed with 3RACHA at the annual Global Citizen Festival, and addressed the need for social change and an end to world poverty! On 3 October 2024, the Superstar donated ₩100 million (US$76,589.47) to the Community Chest of Korea to mark his birthday, supporting people with developmental disabilities by funding health check-up systems and capacity-building training for athletes, and joining the 'Honor Society' of high-value donors. That same month, he participated in W Korea's breast cancer awareness campaign at the "Love Your W" charity event, promoting positive influence and raising awareness about breast cancer! In 2025 he also joined his group members, donating to wildfire relief in the Gyeongsang provinces and the Hong Kong fire recovery. On October 3, 2025, Bang Chan gave 100 million won to Samsung Medical Center for pediatric and adolescent treatment costs and 100 million won to the Korean Committee for UNICEF for children worldwide, which also put him in UNICEF’s Honors Club. On September 19, 2026, he gave another 100 million won to Seoul Rehabilitation Hospital for age- and condition-specific rehab centers, and 100 million won to UNICEF Korea for Nepal flood relief including clean water, health, nutrition, psychosocial support, and temporary classrooms, after floods on August 26 that affected about 84,000 people, including over 32,000 children. He said he wanted to offer a little comfort to people going through exhausting times. Star News put his personal donations at about 500 million won after that gift. 

Bang Chan went from singing the anthem in Sydney to training alone in Seoul at 13, then building Stray Kids from scratch. Fans and members call him a genius leader. Han calls the method discipline. Bang Chan  still looks after younger trainees and holds the group to its old line: 'Never quit"! The daesangs and the record-breaking world-tours are the result of his brilliance with Bang Chan's legacy becoming even bigger this year!

text:
Collins was lucky enough to be given life at Marquette. In re Collins, Michigan’s abolition of the death penalty, and some citizens’ desire to bring it back, here is some real food for thought from a writer America’s founding fathers relied on heavily:

MONTESQUIEU ON PROPORTIONAL PUNISHMENT

(“Dead men tell no tales”) + Michigan’s abolition of the death penalty + application to John Norman Collins

DIRECT QUOTE (The Spirit of the Laws, Book 6, Chapter 16):

“It is a great abuse amongst us to condemn to the same punishment a person that only robs on the highway and another who robs and murders. Surely, for the public security, some difference should be made in the punishment. In China, those who add murder to robbery are cut in pieces: but not so the others; to this difference it is owing that though they rob in that country they never murder. In Russia, where the punishment of robbery and murder is the same, they always murder. The dead, say they, tell no tales. Where there is no difference in the penalty, there should be some in the expectation of pardon. In England they never murder on the highway, because robbers have some hopes of transportation, which is not the case in respect to those that commit murder.”

CORE ANALYSIS: (Montesquieu’s logic):

When the maximum penalty (death) is identical for a lesser crime (robbery) and a greater crime (robbery plus murder), the rational criminal has every incentive to kill the victim. A living witness can identify him; a dead one cannot. Equal severity therefore produces more murders, not fewer. Differentiated penalties (China, England) reduce the incentive to escalate.

ADJUSTMENT in regards  TO MICHIGAN's Current Law:

Michigan abolished capital punishment for murder effective 1 March 1847 — the first English-speaking jurisdiction in the world to do so. The 1963 Constitution made the ban permanent: “No law shall be enacted providing for the penalty of death.” No one has been executed under Michigan law since 1830 (one federal execution occurred in 1938).

In Michigan the maximum penalty is life imprisonment without parole for first-degree murder. Lesser crimes (armed robbery, assault, and so on) carry finite terms. The differential Montesquieu insisted upon therefore still exists: escalating from robbery to murder risks the absolute ceiling of the system (natural life). The classic “dead men tell no tales” incentive is blunted in the same way the English transportation option blunted it.

APPLICATION TO JOHN NORMAN COLLINS (“Ypsilanti Ripper” / “Co-Ed Killer” / “Michigan Murderer”):

Collins is the primary suspect in the 1967–1969 series of at least seven murders of young women in the Ann Arbor–Ypsilanti area. He was convicted only of the final killing (Karen Sue Beineman, 18, July 1969) and, under Michigan law, received the mandatory sentence of life imprisonment. He remains incarcerated more than five decades later.

Because Michigan had already removed the death penalty more than 120 years earlier, Collins faced life rather than execution. His crimes were driven by sexual sadism and control, not by a calculated “dead men tell no tales” calculus aimed at avoiding a higher penalty. Once he had crossed into first-degree murder, the penalty structure offered no further escalation; the state’s long-standing abolition simply meant the maximum available sanction was natural life.

CONCLUSION IN THE MICHIGAN CONTEXT:

Montesquieu’s insight survives the abolition of capital punishment. What matters is proportionality and differentiation within the available scale of penalties. Michigan’s system substitutes life without parole for death and still maintains a sharp distinction between lesser crimes however upon retrospective reflection & perspective perhaps it may be prudent to now Amend Michigan's Constitution to allow the death Penalty for 1st Degree Sexual Offences against Minors & females in which murder occurred via or by & through a premediated & a rens meas intent to conceal the crime in order to avoid the death Penalty which could possibly result under new Amended law... as well as to perhaps in the publi's best interest to amend the law to allow death penalty for any politically or religiously motivated act that results in death. text:
BREAKING: LOL! John Oliver hilariously reveals why he and Seth Meyers ARE THRILLED that Trump hates Jimmy Kimmel more.

Jimmy Kimmel has relocated his show to Brooklyn for a series of episodes, and he took advantage of being in New York City to invite two of his late-night compatriots — HBO’s John Oliver and NBC’s Seth Meyers — to appear as guests. It was a veritable plethora of targets of Donald Trump’s rage on the stage, and the group made sure to aim their comedic talents in their nemesis’s direction.

Kimmel asked the duo about their monthly joint residency at the Beacon Theater in New York City, and John Oliver mentioned that Kimmel often came up during the audience question-and-answer period of their live show. When Kimmel asked why, Oliver responded: Because they'll normally say, “How does it feel being, you know, disliked by the current president? And we always say, as long as you're on the air, we're fine.”

Meyers agreed, saying, “You draw all the ire.”

“We are fully supportive. We are fully behind you, the way that we're fully behind a bulletproof vest,” Oliver added.

When. Kimmel asked why they thought that was, Meyers gave this very plausible theory:

“Other than the fact that you don't like him, we think he would want to hang out with you. I think he sees us as a couple of dorks. And even if we were fans of his, he would have no respect for us. I'm sure he talks to people all the time about, I think he has a pizza oven. Like, everything about him. You know what I mean? He's heard you have, you know, he knows Larry David and Conan. He's got a lot of famous friends. His parties sound awesome.”

“We don't have one pizza oven between us,” Oliver interjected before Meyers continued with: “He looks at us and he's like, ugh.”

Kimmel then pointed out that Trump does occasionally gets upset with Myers and offered his theory as to why John Oliver and even John Stewart don’t elicit the same level of vitriol from Trump.

“I think it's this. I think he's an old man,” Kimmel posited. “And the only channels that are in his brain, or maybe even like in the remote, are the networks. And then he's got Fox News. And then he's got the other ones that maybe he looks in from time to time. So, I think, first of all, I think he doesn't have HBO. So you get a break. (POINTS AT OLIVER) He definitely doesn't have Comedy Central. He has no idea, like most people, no idea where to find that.”

At that point, Meyers interjected: “Do you think when he puts on, when he asks Natalie to put on NBC, do you think he says put on Channel 4?”

“Absolutely. If it is in Washington, Channel 4 is like, yes,” Kimmel responded. “And I also think just as late as he stays up raging and tweeting and whatever it is he does, you're on too late for him. I think you are past his bedtime.”

Meyers concurred: “Well, every time, and again, I will say that when he posts about my show, it is always when it's airing. And it means the world to me. And I don't love it, but like that he's watching linear television with the ads is so important.”

There’s nothing like watching a group of sharp, intelligent, and extremely funny men get together on a stage and rag on Donald Trump. That Jimmy Kimmel brought that into our living rooms, tablets, and phones helps make it a little easier to try to endure the remainder of the Trump era. Long may he continue to bring some joy into our lives.

Please like and share to spread that joy!

text:
The reason we have AI today is because we moved so many aspects of life to the Internet. When we did so we lost a lot more than we gained.

Since then Big Tech has been working to replace what we lost by establishing synthetic means of being able to see, understand, and control what is happening in the digital spaces of e-commerce, communication, entertainment and everything else Internet powered.

We moved into a new “home” for human activity and had to setup new patterns of living in that digital world because the old ways of life were inaccessible. 

The stack of tools we created to do all that gave us new powers: user and behavior profiling, sequencing, relationship discovery, predictability, influence. 

That created a new hypothesis: if we could digitize everything, then we could control and even recreate everything. In the digital world we could become far more powerful than we are in the physical one. We can become gods of that world. Once everything is bits and data, reordering them into whatever form or function we want is simply a matter of coding.

And so here we are in that final stretch of moving the last bits of ourselves into the digital world and to the machines that orchestrate it…and life…on our behalf.

Rather than wondering if AI should be used for this or that, we should be wondering if it was good that we moved so much of life and human activity to the Internet to begin with. Was that initial step good for us or has it led to a downward spiral?

Did we make a mistake? Is the way forward to continue on, or should we go back and recapture what was lost so we can move forward along that original arc of the human story? 

This is a good deal of what I explore in my book, Countering the AI Revolution. We have been deceived, and the path forward in this revolution is one that leads away from humanity, not in favor of preserving it. I offer that we are on the wrong path. We have diverged from the arc of our story and we need to get back to it.

text:
#OnThisDay October 2, 1862: Gateway Contested.

Confederate forces abandoned their fortified position at St. Johns Bluff, east of Jacksonville, after a coordinated Union naval and land expedition threatened to surround the garrison. Although the operation produced no major pitched battle, the evacuation carried substantial military importance. Control of St. Johns Bluff affected access to the St. Johns River, the principal navigable artery into northeastern Florida. The Confederate withdrawal therefore strengthened Union naval access to the river, contributed to another Federal occupation of Jacksonville, and exposed the difficulty Confederate authorities faced in defending Florida's extensive coastline and waterways with limited troops.

The strategic importance of the St. Johns River had become clear during the first year of the Civil War. Jacksonville stood approximately twenty miles upriver from the Atlantic and served as an important transportation and commercial center. Union naval forces could use the river to penetrate the interior, disrupt Confederate transportation, gather intelligence, obtain supplies, and support military operations. Federal forces had occupied Jacksonville in March 1862 but withdrew the following month. Confederate authorities subsequently sought to restrict renewed Union movement along the river.

In early September 1862, Confederate Brigadier General Joseph Finegan directed the establishment of defensive works at St. Johns Bluff. The elevated position stood on the southern side of the river near its lower reaches and offered artillery a commanding field of fire over vessels attempting to pass upstream. Lieutenant Colonel Charles F. Hopkins commanded the Confederate force stationed there. Artillery pieces were placed in prepared earthworks, and Confederate forces also established defenses at nearby Yellow Bluff on the opposite side of the river.

Union commanders quickly recognized that the St. Johns Bluff battery obstructed further operations along the river. Federal gunboats exchanged fire with the Confederate position during September, but naval bombardment alone did not eliminate the defenses. Union authorities therefore organized a combined operation that paired naval power with an infantry movement against the bluff from the landward side.

Brigadier General John Milton Brannan commanded the Federal troops assigned to the expedition. Approximately 1,500 soldiers sailed south from Hilton Head, South Carolina, aboard transports on September 30. Commander Charles Steedman directed the supporting naval force. Union warships operating in the expedition included the USS Paul Jones, USS Cimarron, USS Uncas, USS Patroon, USS Hale, and USS Water Witch. The expedition reached the mouth of the St. Johns River on October 1.

Brannan's troops landed near Mayport and began moving toward the Confederate position. By the evening of October 1, his soldiers, supplies, horses, and weapons had been put ashore. Elements of the 1st Massachusetts Cavalry conducted reconnaissance while Federal infantry prepared to advance through difficult terrain toward the rear of St. Johns Bluff. Naval vessels remained on the river, placing the Confederate defenders under pressure from the water while the land column threatened their communications and escape routes.

On October 2, Hopkins learned that a substantial Federal force was approaching his position from the rear. He consulted his officers and concluded that the garrison lacked sufficient manpower to resist the combined Union operation. Remaining at the bluff risked encirclement and capture. Hopkins therefore ordered the position evacuated. Confederate troops withdrew that night, leaving behind artillery, ammunition, equipment, and prepared defensive works.

Union troops subsequently occupied the abandoned fortifications without having to storm them. A Confederate court of inquiry later investigated Hopkins's decision and concluded that the forces available to him had been insufficient to defend the position successfully. The inquiry exonerated him from misconduct, but the loss nevertheless represented an important Confederate setback in northeastern Florida.

The abandonment of St. Johns Bluff opened the lower St. Johns River to deeper Federal penetration. Union forces soon moved into Jacksonville, beginning the city's second Federal occupation of the war. Although that occupation lasted only several days, the episode demonstrated the Union's ability to combine naval mobility with amphibious land operations against Confederate positions along Florida's waterways.

The October 1862 operation also foreshadowed the recurring military importance of Jacksonville and the St. Johns River. Federal forces returned to Jacksonville in March 1863 and again in February 1864. During the final occupation, Jacksonville became a major Union base for operations into northeastern Florida, including the campaign that culminated in the Battle of Olustee. Union gunboats repeatedly used the St. Johns River to transport soldiers, patrol waterways, raid Confederate positions, and support Federal forces ashore.

The evacuation of St. Johns Bluff was therefore significant beyond the immediate capture of one artillery position. It demonstrated the strategic advantage created by Union naval superiority along Florida's Atlantic coast and the difficulties faced by Confederate commanders defending isolated coastal positions. On October 2, 1862, the Confederacy lost a key barrier protecting Jacksonville and the St. Johns River. The withdrawal helped establish a pattern that would shape military operations in northeastern Florida for the remainder of the Civil War.

You might challenge it.

You might argue with it.

But “later”?

Later sounds reasonable.

Later sounds responsible.

Later makes you feel like you haven't given up.

You're still going to start the business.

You're still going to learn the skill.

You're still going to fix your finances.

You're still going to apply for the better job.

You're still going to write the book.

You're still going to build the website.

You're still going to launch the product.

You're still going to create the content.

You're still going to change your life.

Just not today.

And that's exactly why “later” can steal YEARS from you without you even noticing.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💔 LET ME SHOW YOU HOW IT HAPPENS.

Imagine a 32-year-old man named Marcus.

Marcus has a decent job.

Nothing terrible.

But nothing he wants to do forever either.

Every morning, his alarm rings at 6:15.

He gets dressed.

Drives to work.

Works all day.

Comes home tired.

Eats.

Checks his phone.

Watches videos.

Scrolls through social media.

Goes to sleep.

Repeat.

Monday.

Tuesday.

Wednesday.

Thursday.

Friday.

Then the weekend arrives.

Marcus tells himself:

“This weekend I'm finally going to start.”

Saturday morning comes.

He's exhausted from the week.

“Let me rest for a few hours.”

A few hours become most of the day.

Sunday arrives.

Now Monday is approaching.

“I'll start properly next weekend.”

Nothing dramatic happened.

Nobody destroyed Marcus's dream.

Nobody told him he couldn't do it.

He simply postponed it by seven days.

That doesn't sound dangerous.

Until you understand something:

Life is built from seven-day periods.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

One week becomes a month.

A month becomes six months.

Six months becomes:

“Wow, this year went quickly.”

Then New Year's Eve arrives.

Marcus promises himself:

🔥 “NEXT YEAR WILL BE DIFFERENT.”

January comes.

He watches motivational videos.

Downloads some apps.

Buys a notebook.

Writes down goals.

For three days, he feels unstoppable.

Then life happens.

Work becomes stressful.

An unexpected expense arrives.

The children need something.

He's tired.

Motivation disappears.

And quietly...

He returns to normal.

Another year begins disappearing.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚨 NOW HERE'S THE PART MOST PEOPLE DON'T WANT TO THINK ABOUT.

Marcus turns 35.

Then 38.

Then 42.

The idea is still there.

But now the conversation sounds different.

At 32:

“I've got plenty of time.”

At 35:

“I really need to start.”

At 38:

“I wish I'd started a few years ago.”

At 42:

“Is it too late?”

Nothing suddenly happened at 42.

There was no single catastrophic decision.

There were simply thousands of ordinary days when Marcus chose:

Not today.

That's how enormous regrets are sometimes created.

Not by one terrible decision.

But by thousands of tiny delays.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⏰ NOW IMAGINE SOMETHING UNCOMFORTABLE.

Tonight, before you sleep, you receive a message.

It's from you.

Ten years from today.

You open it.

It says:

“I need to talk to you.”

Suddenly, your future self is sitting opposite you.

You stare at them.

Older face.

Older eyes.

A decade of experiences you haven't lived yet.

You ask:

“How did everything turn out?”

They don't answer immediately.

Instead, they ask:

“Why didn't you start?”

Your stomach drops.

“Start what?”

They look at you.

“Don't do that. You know exactly what I'm talking about.”

That thing you've been thinking about for months.

Maybe years.

You begin defending yourself.

“I didn't have enough money.”

They answer:

“You didn't need all the money. You needed to start learning.”

“I didn't have enough time.”

“You were spending hours every week scrolling.”

“I didn't know what to do.”

“You had access to more information than almost any generation in history.”

“I wasn't ready.”

“You were never going to feel completely ready.”

“I was afraid of failing.”

Your future self pauses.

Then says:

💔 “So instead, you guaranteed that you would never find out.”

Silence.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 THAT IS THE QUESTION YOU NEED TO ASK YOURSELF.

Not only:

“What if I fail?”

Ask:

“What happens if I DON'T try?”

People calculate the risk of action constantly.

“What if the business fails?”

“What if nobody watches?”

“What if nobody buys?”

“What if they reject me?”

“What if I lose money?”

“What if people laugh?”

Fair questions.

But where is your calculation for the risk of doing nothing?

What if you spend another five years in work you hate?

What if your financial situation remains exactly the same?

What if somebody launches the idea you kept talking about?

What if you never discover what you were capable of?

What if you spend thousands more hours consuming other people's lives instead of building your own?

Doing nothing is also a decision.

And it has consequences too.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💥 LET'S DESTROY ONE MYTH RIGHT NOW.

You do NOT need to “change your life today.”

That's overwhelming.

You don't need to quit your job.

You don't need to invest your savings.

You don't need to start five businesses.

You don't need to wake up at 4:00 a.m.

You don't need to work 18 hours a day.

You don't need to buy another $2,000 course.

You don't need to pretend you're going to become a millionaire next month.

You need something much simpler.

PROOF.

Proof to yourself that you're no longer just talking.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Want to write a book?

Don't tell me:

📚 “I'm going to become an author.”

Write 500 words tonight.

Want to create content?

Don't spend three weeks choosing the perfect username.

🎥 Publish one useful piece of content.

Want to start a business?

Don't spend six months designing logos.

🤝 Find one real person with a real problem you might be able to solve.

Want to improve your finances?

Don't announce:

💰 “This is my millionaire year.”

Open your bank statement.

Look at where your money actually went.

Create a realistic budget.

Save something.

Want a better career?

Don't spend another year complaining about your employer.

📧 Improve your CV.

Learn a relevant skill.

Send the first application.

Want to learn AI?

Stop saving 300 AI videos you'll never watch.

🤖 Choose one tool and actually learn how to use it.

Want to build an audience?

Stop worrying about reaching 100,000 people.

Create something useful for the first 10.

That's how real change usually begins.

Not with an announcement.

With evidence.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚨 AND STOP WAITING FOR MOTIVATION.

Motivation is unreliable.

You've experienced this yourself.

At 11:00 p.m., you watch an inspirational video and think:

🔥 “THAT'S IT. TOMORROW EVERYTHING CHANGES.”

Tomorrow arrives.

The alarm rings.

You're tired.

Suddenly the person who wanted to conquer the world eight hours ago wants another 30 minutes of sleep. 😂

That's normal.

You cannot build your future around constantly feeling inspired.

You need something stronger:

A system that still works when you DON'T feel like doing it.

Thirty minutes.

One page.

One application.

One customer contact.

One workout.

One lesson.

One video.

One small deposit.

Again tomorrow.

Again next week.

Again next month.

Boring?

Absolutely.

Powerful?

Extremely.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📈 BECAUSE SMALL ACTIONS LOOK WEAK UNTIL THEY COMPOUND.

Imagine two people.

Both want to learn a valuable skill.

Person A spends six months researching:

“What's the best course?”

“What's the best laptop?”

“Which software?”

“Is AI going to replace this?”

“Is the market saturated?”

“What niche should I choose?”

“Should I start now?”

They watch hundreds of videos.

They know all the terminology.

But they've produced almost nothing.

Person B chooses one direction.

They're not certain it's perfect.

They study for one hour a day.

And they practice.

Day 1:

They're terrible.

Day 30:

Still a beginner.

Day 100:

Something starts happening.

Day 365:

They've accumulated hundreds of hours of learning and practice.

Now compare them.

Person A may have spent a year thinking about becoming good.

Person B spent a year becoming better.

🔥 THAT DIFFERENCE CAN CHANGE A LIFE.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💔 “BUT I'M ALREADY BEHIND.”

Behind whom?

The 22-year-old millionaire on your timeline?

The entrepreneur showing their Lamborghini?

The creator with two million followers?

The person who started 10 years before you?

Stop.

You don't know their full story.

You don't know their advantages.

You don't know their debt.

You don't know their failures.

You don't know whether the lifestyle you're seeing is even real.

And most importantly:

Their timeline cannot give you your time back.

If you're 25…

Start at 25.

If you're 35…

Start at 35.

If you're 45…

Start at 45.

If you're 55…

Start at 55.

Because there's something worse than starting at 45.

Being 50 and wishing you'd started at 45.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚨 “BUT WHAT IF I FAIL?”

You probably will fail at something.

Let's stop pretending otherwise.

Your first idea might be bad.

Your first video might flop.

Your first product might not sell.

Your first application might be rejected.

Your first business might fail.

Your first advertisement might lose money.

Your first strategy might be completely wrong.

But failure contains information.

It can tell you:

“This offer isn't strong enough.”

“This skill needs improvement.”

“This audience doesn't want this.”

“This pricing doesn't work.”

“This strategy needs changing.”

“This wasn't the right opportunity.”

“This is where I need help.”

Failure can become feedback.

But doing absolutely nothing?

It teaches you almost nothing.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🧠 THIS IS WHY YOUR LANGUAGE MATTERS.

Stop saying:

❌ “I can't do it.”

Say:

✅ “I don't know how to do it yet.”

Stop saying:

❌ “I don't have enough money.”

Ask:

✅ “What's the smallest responsible version I can test?”

Stop saying:

❌ “I'm unlucky.”

Ask:

✅ “What can I actually control?”

Stop saying:

❌ “Nobody will buy.”

Ask:

✅ “What problem would somebody genuinely pay me to solve?”

Stop saying:

❌ “I'm too late.”

Ask:

✅ “If I start today, where could I be three years from now?”

Stop saying:

❌ “I'll start when I'm ready.”

Say:

🔥 “I'LL START SMALL ENOUGH THAT I DON'T NEED TO FEEL READY.”

That's different.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⏰ NOW THINK ABOUT THREE YEARS FROM TODAY.

Three years sounds like a long time.

It's not.

Think about where you were three years ago.

Doesn't it feel surprisingly recent?

The next three years will probably disappear just as quickly.

So imagine what could happen if, instead of waiting for some huge breakthrough, you spent those three years consistently improving.

1 hour a day.

That's roughly 365 hours in a year.

Over three years?

More than 1,000 hours.

Imagine 1,000 hours spent deliberately improving one valuable ability.

Writing.

Sales.

Marketing.

Programming.

Teaching.

Cybersecurity.

Design.

Video editing.

AI.

Public speaking.

A trade.

A profession.

A business skill.

Whatever genuinely fits your goals.

Would you be guaranteed to become wealthy?

No.

Would success be guaranteed?

No.

But would you likely be far more capable than the person who spent those same three years saying:

“I'll start soon”?

That's the point.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

❤️ NOW IMAGINE YOUR FUTURE SELF AGAIN.

Ten years have passed.

This time, they're smiling.

You ask:

“What happened?”

They say:

“A lot.”

“Was it easy?”

They laugh.

“Absolutely not.”

“Did everything work?”

“No.”

“Did we fail?”

“Many times.”

“Did we ever want to quit?”

“More times than you can imagine.”

“Then why are you smiling?”

Your future self looks at you and says:

❤️ “Because you gave me something incredibly valuable.”

“What?”

“A chance.”

You started.

You didn't guarantee success.

You couldn't.

You simply refused to guarantee regret.

You learned.

You tried.

You adjusted.

You failed.

You improved.

You continued.

And because you started…

your future had possibilities that wouldn't have existed otherwise.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 SO I'M NOT ASKING YOU TO CHANGE YOUR ENTIRE LIFE TODAY.

I'm asking you to stop lying to yourself about “later.”

Choose the thing you've been postponing.

Then shrink it.

Shrink it again.

Until the first step becomes so small that your excuses sound ridiculous.

Don't say:

“I need to build a company.”

Say:

“I need to speak to one potential customer.”

Don't say:

“I need financial freedom.”

Say:

“Tonight I'm reviewing my finances.”

Don't say:

“I need to become an expert.”

Say:

“Tonight I'm studying for 30 minutes.”

Don't say:

“I need 100,000 followers.”

Say:

“Today I'm publishing post number one.”

Don't say:

“I need to completely change my life.”

Say:

🔥 “TODAY, I'M CHANGING MY DIRECTION.”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚨 BECAUSE YOUR LIFE MAY NOT CHANGE TODAY.

Your bank balance might look exactly the same tomorrow morning.

Your business might still have zero customers.

Your video might get 23 views.

Your application might receive no reply.

Nobody may notice what you did.

Nobody may congratulate you.

Nobody may even know you've started.

That's okay.

Because the first victory isn't money.

It isn't followers.

It isn't applause.

It isn't recognition.

The first victory is being able to look at yourself tonight and say:

❤️ “I finally did something instead of just thinking about it.”

And tomorrow?

Do something again.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💥 ONE FINAL QUESTION.

Imagine you're given two envelopes.

One contains a video of your life 10 years from now if you continue exactly as you are today.

The other contains your life 10 years from now if you begin taking consistent action toward the things you keep saying you want.

Which envelope would you be more afraid to open?

Think about that.

Because your answer might tell you something.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

👇 NOW DON'T JUST COMMENT “I'M STARTING.”

Write the actual thing.

Finish this sentence:

🔥 “I'VE BEEN POSTPONING __________. TODAY MY FIRST STEP IS __________.”

Make it specific.

“I've been postponing my business. Today I'll contact my first potential customer.”

“I've been postponing learning. Tonight I'll study for 30 minutes.”

“I've been postponing saving. Today I'll create my first automatic transfer.”

“I've been postponing content. Today I'll publish my first video.”

Make the commitment real.

❤️ LIKE this if you needed the reminder.

🔁 SHARE THIS WITH ONE PERSON WHO KEEPS SAYING, “I'LL START SOMEDAY.”

📌 SAVE it if you need to read it again when your excuses return.

But please remember:

Saving this post is not action.

Sharing this post is not action.

Commenting on this post is not action.

What you do after reading it is what matters.

Put your phone down.

Take the first step.

Even if it's tiny.

Even if you're afraid.

Even if nobody believes in you yet.

Even if you don't know exactly where it will lead.

Because someday, you are going to meet the consequences of what you do today.

And when that day comes…

I hope your future self doesn't have to ask:

💔 “Why did you keep waiting?”

I hope they get to look back at this version of you and say:

❤️ “Thank you.”

Thank you for starting scared.

Thank you for starting small.

Thank you for starting imperfectly.

🔥 BUT MOST OF ALL…
 
THANK YOU FOR STARTING. #viralcontent #makimngmoneyonline

text:
Damn Grok disagrees:

"The claim that Epstein was an intellectual peer of the people he cultivated is the part that does not survive contact with the record. Separating that from the moral question is straightforward; treating the praise as some brave truth-seeking exercise is not.

Intelligence and predation are not mutually exclusive. High cognitive ability, social fluency, and the ability to hold a room have never been a moral defense, and history is full of capable people who used those traits to do harm. Acknowledging the trait is not the same as elevating it. The problem with the formulation is narrower: it treats Epstein’s self-presentation and the willingness of famous people to sit with him as evidence that he was “off-the-charts, scary intelligent,” then presents dissent from that portrait as hysteria. That overclaims the evidence and misreads why the associations existed.

Epstein had no degree. He attended Cooper Union and NYU without finishing, then taught math and physics at Dalton without the credentials the school normally required. His later reputation rested on money, access, a private island, a Manhattan townhouse, and a talent for making powerful people feel that proximity to him was useful or flattering. Academics and scientists took the meetings and the funding. That is evidence about incentives and status, not a controlled demonstration that he was operating at the level of Marvin Minsky or Noam Chomsky. People who control discretionary capital and exclusive social access routinely receive inflated assessments of their intellect from the people who want the capital or the access. The same pattern appears with other wealthy fixers who were later shown to be more operator than originator.

The public record of Epstein speaking at length does not match the “scary intelligent” description either. Extended interviews and deposition footage show a man who was glib, name-dropping, and evasive, with a conversational style built on proximity to other people’s ideas rather than sustained original argument. Charm and a prepared reading list are real skills. They are also ordinary tools of social climbers. Calling the gap between that record and the myth “nobody wants to admit the truth” reverses the burden: the extraordinary claim is the one that needs extraordinary evidence beyond “smart people took his calls and some of them said nice things.”

The praise is also irrelevant to the conduct that made him notorious. The 2008 Florida plea was to procuring a minor for prostitution and soliciting prostitution; the 2019 federal indictment charged sex trafficking of minors, including girls as young as 14, with a conspiracy count. Victim accounts describe grooming, payment, recruitment of other minors, and the use of his properties and staff. Those facts do not become less central because he could discuss science over dinner or because Steve Bannon or Alan Dershowitz found him stimulating. Fixating on the intellect frame shifts attention from the mechanism of the harm—status, money, isolation, and calculated charm—to a trait that does not explain or mitigate it. Predatory operations frequently rely on exactly the qualities being praised: seduction, perceived sophistication, deceit, and the ability to make targets and enablers feel chosen. Noting that is description, not hysteria.

There is a further practical cost. Public praise of a convicted child sex offender’s mind, offered as a corrective to “blithering hysteria,” functions as status restoration even when the speaker adds a disclaimer. It tells audiences that the interesting question is how impressive he was, and that people who refuse that framing are being irrational. Victims and the evidentiary record already compete with conspiracy content, celebrity adjacency, and retrospective reputation management. Adding an unsolicited brief for his intellect does not clarify the case; it supplies language that admirers and minimizers reuse. The same move appears whenever a high-status offender’s charm or competence is treated as the under-appreciated truth. It is not required for understanding what happened, and it is not neutral.

Tracey’s own disclaimer—that noting the intellect is not an endorsement of everything Epstein did—is formally correct and still misses the point. No one needed permission to observe that Epstein was socially effective. The insistence that this is the suppressed fact, and that it grows “truer” the more insiders are consulted, is what reads as special pleading. Insiders are the population whose judgment was already compromised by access and self-interest. Their retrospective compliments are weak evidence of exceptional intelligence and weaker evidence that the public has been unfair to his memory."

text:
Pharaoh God Mob is a generative art project that invents a post-collapse mythology rather than retelling history. It explores what symbols, hierarchies, and gods might emerge after civilizations fracture, built around dualities of spirit and machine, ritual and survival, and memory and reinvention.

The collection forms a unified pantheon of generative gods assembled from 179 designed attributes. Its core figures are chakra-based entities and robotic counterparts that represent balance, energy, and transformation, with color used as a system of identity and power. Each figure is meant to function as both a collectible and a symbol within a larger visual language.

Twenty one-of-one paintings act as the world’s genesis works. They were shown publicly during Miami Art Week in Wynwood as a preview of the physical exhibitions, environments, and activations the project aims to offer. The NFT collection is framed as an entry point into a broader ecosystem that may grow through exhibitions, physical art, sound, and live experiences, with ownership treated as ongoing access to that world.

Pour forth your divine grace upon us, dear Mother, and restore us to a state of wholeness, that we may bear witness to the miracle of your love. Amen.

Prayer to St. Jude:

Oh glorious apostle St. Jude, faithful servant and friend of Jesus, the name of the traitor who delivered thy beloved Master into the hands of His enemies has caused thee to be forgotten by many, but the Church honors and invokes thee universally as the patron of hopeless cases--of things despaired of. Pray for me who am so miserable; make use, I implore thee, of that particular privilege accorded thee of bringing visible and speedy help where help is almost despaired of. Come to my assistance in this great need, that I may receive the consolations and succor of heaven in all my necessities, tribulations and sufferings, particularly—completely heal and protect Charlotte  —and that I may bless God with thee and all the elect throughout eternity. I promise thee, O blessed St. Jude, to be ever mindful of this great favor, and I will never cease to honor thee as my special and powerful patron, and to do all in my power to encourage devotion to thee. Prayer to St. Michael (Long Version)

O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and fearful warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come thou to the assistance of men, whom Almighty God created immortal, making them in His own image and likeness and redeeming them at a great price from the tyranny of Satan. Fight this day the battle of the Lord with thy legions of holy Angels, even as of old thou didst fight against Lucifer, the leader of the proud spirits and all his rebel angels, who were powerless to stand against thee, neither was their place found any more in heaven. And that great dragon was cast forth, the ancient serpent, who is called the devil and satan, who seduces the whole world; and he was cast forth upon Earth, and his angels were sent with him.

But behold! the ancient enemy of mankind and a murderer from the beginning has been fiercely aroused. Changing himself into an angel of light, he goes about with the whole multitude of the wicked spirits to invade the earth and blot out the Name of God and of His Christ, to plunder, to slay, and to consign to eternal damnation the souls that have been destined for a crown of everlasting life. This wicked serpent, like an unclean torrent, pours into men of depraved minds and corrupt hearts the poison of his malice, the spirit of lying, impiety and blasphemy, and the deadly breath of impurity and every form of vice and iniquity.

Be favorable to Thy Church, the Bride of the Lamb without spot, whose enemies have filled to overflowing with gall and inebriated with wormwood. They have laid profane hands upon Her most sacred treasures. Where the See of the most blessed Peter and the Chair of Truth has been constituted as a light to the nations, there they have placed a throne of their abomination and impiety; so that with the Pastor struck, they may prevail to disperse the flock.

Therefore, most invincible Leader, be with the people of God against this spiritual wickedness and bring about victory. Thou art venerated by Holy Church as Her guard and patron; Thou art glorified as our defender against the impious powers of earth and of hell. Unto thee the Lord hath handed over the souls of the redeemed to be placed in happiness above.

Entreat the God of peace, to obliterate satan beneath our feet, lest he prevail further to hold men captive, and to injure the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercy of the Lord may swiftly overtake us, and apprehend the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and send him bound into the abyss, so that he may seduce the nations no more.

The Lion of the tribe of Juda has conquered, the root of David.
Let Thy mercies be upon us, O Lord.
As we have hoped in Thee.
O Lord, hear my prayer.
And let my cry come unto Thee.
The Lord be with you all.
And with thy spirit.

Let us pray.
O God, and Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, we invoke Thy Holy Name, and we humbly implore Thy clemency so that, through the intercession of Mary, the Immaculate ever-Virgin Mother of God, of blessed Michael the Archangel, of blessed Joseph, the Spouse of the same blessed Virgin, of the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all the Saints, Thou may deign to offer us aid against satan, and all the other unclean spirits, who wander through the world to injure the human race and to destroy souls. We ask this through Christ Our Lord. Amen.

By the power of the Holy Spirit and by His authority, I ask Jesus Christ to break any and all curses, hexes, vexes, jinks, spells, and all wrong prayers and words, and to send them all back to where they came from, if it be His Holy Will. I beseech Thee, Lord Jesus Christ, to protect us by pouring Thy Precious Blood on us; myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for; which Thou hast shed for us and I ask Thee to command that any departing spirits leave quietly, without disturbance, and go straight to Thy Cross to be disposed of as Thou sees fit. I place myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for, and all things I pray and intercede for under the protection of the Blood of Jesus Christ which He has shed for us. Remove fear, anxiety, and complications, replacing them with Your peace and assurance. Restore her health, strength, and vitality quickly, and surround her with Your loving presence. Great to see the Joy Ridge rows looking that dialed—Sonoma coastal conditions clearly suit those plants. On the indoor vs outdoor question, same genetics and a proper cure make the blind test the right way to settle it. Research comparing matched cultivars has generally found sun-grown flower expressing a broader terpene range (especially certain sesquiterpenes) and fewer oxidized cannabinoids, while indoor offers tighter environmental control and consistency. In practice the grower’s skill, drying, and cure usually matter more than the room or the field. Looking forward to seeing how the nose and palate call it.

It stays neutral, references the actual farm context and available comparative data, and keeps the focus on the taste test the original post proposed.
